description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Icon', a data marker that uses an image as an icon within the PEAR Image_Graph library. It includes methods for setting the icon's filename, positioning, and rendering the icon on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
classes.description: A class for creating image icon markers in the PEAR Image_Graph library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the icon marker with a filename and optional size.

methods.name: setPointX
methods.description: Sets the X coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: setPointY
methods.description: Sets the Y coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the icon marker on the canvas at specified coordinates.
